summary: Stops SqlValidatorImpl from overwriting OFFSET and FETCH on an inner SELECT when pushing an outer ORDER BY into it, so a FETCH added by a custom rewrite (e.g. ROWNUM) is kept.

tests.evidence: Bug fix; julianhyde objected to the original synthetic test, mihaibudiu asked for a Quidem test or an explanation of why only a custom validator reproduces it, and for the test to reference the Jira.

user_docs.evidence: Internal validator fix; no option or documented behavior.

doc_comments.evidence: Reviewer asked for Javadoc naming CALCITE-7761 on the new test and a comment explaining that the tree shape comes only from external rewrites; both were added in the final version.

change_description.evidence: Title matches the Jira and the description gives the ROWNUM example; reviewer noted the term 'pagination' was unclear.

backward_compat.evidence: Changes rewrite output only for trees with OFFSET/FETCH on the inner SELECT, which Calcite's parser does not produce; affects downstream validators that override performUnconditionalRewrites.

correctness.evidence: Small guard in two symmetric branches; reviewer called the fix safe.

contradictions.evidence: The comment above both branches was rewritten alongside the code and matches it.

spec_conformance.evidence: FETCH-then-ORDER-BY must keep SQL semantics (limit applied before the outer sort); the wrap into a subquery does that.

plan.why: A two-branch validator guard; one reviewer can cover the test adequacy and comments.
